info.title: APX — APDS Parking eXtensions
info.summary: An open companion standard to APDS 4.1
info.description:
**APX (APDS Parking eXtensions)** is an additive companion standard to the
[APDS 4.1 API](https://github.com/parkingdata/spec) (Alliance for Parking
Data Standards, published as ISO/TS 5206-1).

APX follows an **APDS-first prime directive**: wherever APDS 4.1 already
defines a route, schema, or convention, APX uses it verbatim (by `$ref`
into the vendored, unmodified `apds-api-4.1.yaml`). APX only adds what
APDS deliberately leaves out:

- **Data profile** — Full/Change update semantics, tombstones, and a
  cursor-based change feed as additive parameters on APDS's native routes
- **Delivery fabric** — a superset-compatible profile of APDS `/webhooks`
  (HMAC signing, normative retries, delivery ledger, SSE)
- **Control** — command plane for gates/PARCS/devices with idempotency,
  lifecycle, and immutable audit
- **Alerts** — operational alerting with open taxonomies via APDS
  UserDefinedCodeLists
- **Discovery** — credential-scoped capability documents
- **Accounts & payments, LPR, reservations, permits, tolling** — profiles
  and additive resources over APDS entities

Extension identity follows the official APDS extension convention:
`apds-ext:apx:<class>@<version>` (Use Case Document §C.2.5), with
extensionName `apx`.

get.description:
Lists `Observations` and allows searching/filtering by:

* latitude, longitude, radius: to check for `Observations` within a geographic area
* a list of `Places`, to retrieve all Observations within a set of parking locations
* start_before: to get observations starting before a given instant
* end_before: to get observations ending before a given instant
* start_after: to get observations starting after a given instant
* end_after: to get observations ending after a given instant
* a modification instant: to only display changed resources from that point onwards

Additionally, supports providing a comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to an `Observation` that should be included in the result set. If unused or left blank, `none` will be assumed.

across retries). Respond 2xx to acknowledge; anything else triggers
the normative retry schedule (Part 8).

apxOAuth.description:
OAuth 2.0 client-credentials (aligned with APDS 4.1's `oAuth` scheme).
APX scopes follow `apx.<domain>:<verb>`. Grants are carried in the
normative token claims `apx_org` (Organisation reference) and
`apx_places` (HierarchyElement UUID subtree grants; absent = all).

scopes.apx.data:read: Read parking data via APDS-native routes
scopes.apx.data:write: Create/update parking data via APDS-native routes
scopes.apx.control:read: Read commands, lanes, and device status
scopes.apx.control:execute: Execute commands (vend gate, lost ticket, push rate, apply validation…)
scopes.apx.payments:write: Take payments and post accounting write-backs

RecordInfo.title: RecordInfo
RecordInfo.description:
Provenance metadata for an APX resource, aligned to the APDS Information
Model's RecordType (creationTime/creator/lastUpdate). All timestamps are
RFC 3339 (APDS DateTime).

creationUser.description: Human or system principal that created the record.

lastUpdateUser.description: Human or system principal that last updated the record.

Extensions.title: Extensions
Extensions.description:
The official APDS extension container (Use Case Document §C.2.5).
Keys MUST follow `apds-ext:<namespace>:<class>@<major>.<minor>`.
Implementations MUST preserve unknown extension keys on round-trip
(tolerant reader, faithful writer).

ApxResourceCore.title: ApxResourceCore
ApxResourceCore.description:
Identity core shared by every APX-defined resource. Shaped so any APX
resource can itself be the target of an APDS Reference or
VersionedReference (RFC 4122 UUID identifier + integer version).

id.description: RFC 4122 UUID, unique within the resource class.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description:
RFC 9457 problem details. APX problem `type` URIs are registered in the
APX problem-type registry. Used for all APX error responses; APDS-native
routes may alternatively use the APDS ResponseStatus shape.

type.description: Problem type URI from the APX problem registry.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this specific occurrence.

EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope
EventEnvelope.description:
The single envelope for all APX asynchronous delivery (webhooks and SSE).
Attribute names are aligned with CloudEvents 1.0 (informative mapping in
the standard's annex); `subject` carries an APDS Reference so events bind
to APDS/APX entities natively.

id.description: Unique event id (delivery-stable; retries reuse it).

type.description:
Event topic. Either an APX topic (`apx.<domain>.<event>.vN`) or an
APDS EventTypeEnum value (e.g. `SessionCreated`).

subject.description: The entity this event is about.

dataschema.description: Optional URI of the schema that `data` validates against.

data.description: Event payload. For APDS EventTypeEnum topics this is the APDS EventData shape.

CodeListValue.title: CodeListValue
CodeListValue.description:
A value drawn from an APX or implementer UserDefinedCodeList — carries the
defined value plus an optional ReferencedCodeListEntry-style pointer to
the list that defines it.

value.description: The definedValue from the code list entry.

ChangeFeedPage.title: ChangeFeedPage
ChangeFeedPage.description:
Response of a native APDS list route when called with `mode=change`.
Items are VERBATIM APDS entities carrying only changed fields plus
identity (change semantics per Part 5: explicit null = clear the field,
absent = unchanged — generalizing APDS Use Case C.1.1.6). Deletions are
APDS DeletedReferences (tombstones).

items.description: Changed APDS entities of the route's class (verbatim APDS schemas).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor to resume AFTER the last change in this page.

next.description: Link to the next page when more changes are immediately available; null otherwise.

ApxEventSubscription.title: ApxEventSubscription

id.description: Assigned at creation; used with DELETE/PATCH /webhooks/{id}.

endpoint.description: Client endpoint URL for webhook deliveries (required for transport=webhook).

topics.description:
APDS EventTypeEnum values (e.g. SessionCreated) and/or APX topics
(apx.<domain>.<event>.vN) — freely mixed.

places.description: Only events bound to these HierarchyElement subtrees are delivered.

severityFloor.description: For alert topics — minimum severity delivered.

secret.description:
HMAC signing secret (write-only; server-generated when absent and
returned once in the creation response).

status.description: failed = retry schedule exhausted; PATCH status=active to resume.

DeliveryRecord.title: DeliveryRecord
DeliveryRecord.description: One entry in a subscription's delivery ledger.

lastCode.description: Last HTTP status code received from the endpoint (0 = network error).

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description:
An operational condition requiring attention. Alert types are OPEN
(UserDefinedCodeList `apx-alert-types`, seeded from APDS Use Case C.2.2
transaction exceptions and space statuses); severity is CLOSED.

alertType.description: definedValue from apx-alert-types or an implementer code list.

relatedEntity.description: The APDS/APX entity this alert concerns (Session, AssignedRight, Command…).

occurrenceTime.description: When the condition actually occurred (may precede detection).

actor.description: Client/agent principal that caused the transition.

Command.title: Command
Command.description:
A request for an operational action against a lane/device/place.
Perishable (expiryTime), idempotent (Idempotency-Key), fully audited
(immutable statusHistory).

commandType.description: definedValue from apx-command-types (vendGate, lostTicket, pushRate, applyValidation, …).

target.description:
Reference to the target — SupplementalEquipment (device) or a
VehicularAccess/Place HierarchyElement (lane/place scope).

parameters.description:
Command-type-specific parameters. Normative parameter schemas per
commandType are given in Part 6 (e.g. lostTicket.method,
pushRate.rateTable VersionedReference, applyValidation.ticket +
provider, displayMessage.message, setDeviceState.state).

requestedBy.description: The agent/organisation requesting the action (defaults to the token's apx_org).

reason.description: Free-text or code-list reason for the action (audit).

expiryTime.description: Commands are perishable — MUST NOT be dispatched after this instant.

statusHistory.description: Immutable, append-only lifecycle audit — THE audit trail (Part 4 §4.2).

DeviceStatus.title: DeviceStatus
DeviceStatus.description:
Live state overlay keyed by Reference to an APDS SupplementalEquipment —
never duplicates its descriptive fields. deviceState values mirror the
RefillPointStatusEnum style (registry apx-device-states). Attachable to
APDS payloads as apds-ext:apx:devicestatus@1.0.

LaneStatus.title: LaneStatus
LaneStatus.description:
The transaction context at a lane right now (2018 requirement ① —
call-center screen-pop). Composes APDS references and data; adds no
parallel entities.

currentTicket.description: The ticket/credential currently in the machine, if any.

providerName.description: Human-readable vendor name (from the place's ValidationProvider list).

validationType.description: The provider's validation type at time of application.

validationId.description: Unique id of this applied validation — maps to APDS Segment.validationId.

amountReduced.description: The ACTUAL value this validation removed from the amount due (dispute evidence).

lpr.description: Latest plate read at this lane (APDS Observation-derived).

monthlyCredential.description: Monthly-parker credential context at the lane, if presented.

recentEvents.description: The last 10 activity events on this credential (trend view).

ValidationProvider.title: ValidationProvider
ValidationProvider.description: A venue/organisation allowed to validate tickets at a place (2018 requirement ⑤).

validationType.description: e.g. flat discount, hours comped — implementer code list.

benefit.description:
What the validation is WORTH — disclosed in the lookup so agents can
answer disputes. Exactly one of amount (money off) or duration
(comped time, priced at the applicable rate) applies.

duration.description: Comped parking time (ISO 8601), valued at the applicable rate.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A billable parking account (monthly parker, fleet…), anchored on an APDS RightHolder.

cardNumber.description: Access credential number (NOT a payment card PAN).

PaymentRecord.title: PaymentRecord
PaymentRecord.description: A payment taken through APX (maps to the APDS Payment concept; card capture stays in the implementer's PCI scope).

method.description: card | autoAttendant | cash | other (implementer code list). autoAttendant = PCI-compliant IVR captures the card out of band.

cardLast4.description:
Truncated payment-card digits (PCI-permitted). For transient parkers
with no LPR and no readable ticket, this is often the ONLY key a
caller can provide — the lookup of last resort.

postings.description: Accounting write-backs (PARIS-style) applied for this payment.

Posting.title: Posting
Posting.description: An accounting write-back of a payment to a monthly-parking/AR system (2018 requirement ⑨).

LprRead.title: LprRead
LprRead.description: One plate read joined with its ticket/session context.

recentReservations.description:
The same customer's last 10 reservations (newest first) — customer
resolved from the plate via the account registry or the
reservation's own vehicle credentials.

ReservationExtension.title: ReservationExtension
ReservationExtension.description:
The apds-ext:apx:reservation@1.0 extension object attached to a native
AssignedRight. Presence of this extension marks the AssignedRight as a
reservation; state transitions follow Part 14.

checkInSession.description: Set when a Session referencing this AssignedRight is created.

ReservationSummary.title: ReservationSummary
ReservationSummary.description: Compact view of one past/current reservation, for customer-history lookups.

PoolAvailability.title: PoolAvailability
PoolAvailability.description: Availability of a pooled RightSpecification (APDS RightPool profile).

PermitIssueRequest.title: PermitIssueRequest
PermitIssueRequest.description:
Issue a permit from a pooled RightSpecification — creates a native
AssignedRight with (possibly multiple) vehicle credentials, per the APDS
annual-permit use case (one right, multiple vehicles).

credentials.description: Vehicle credentials (e.g. plates) usable under this one permit.

TollTransaction.title: TollTransaction
TollTransaction.description:
A toll charge assembled from plate/transponder reads: Observation refs →
pricing → Payment ref, with a dispute lifecycle.

payment.description: Reference to the settling PaymentRecord/APDS Payment.

DiscoveryDocument.title: DiscoveryDocument
DiscoveryDocument.description:
What THIS credential can do: exactly the endpoints, commands, topics,
and places reachable with the presented token's scopes and grants.
Two clients with different grants receive different documents; a client
can call everything its document lists and nothing more.

client.description: The OAuth client id this document was computed for.

conformanceClasses.description: Server classes usable by this client (intersection with its scopes).

places.description:
Granted HierarchyElement subtree roots (token claim apx_places).
An empty array means ALL places are visible to this client.

commandTypes.description: Command types this client may execute (empty without apx.control:execute).

topics.description: Topics this client may subscribe to.

conformanceClasses.description: APX conformance classes this implementation supports.

registries.description: Locations of the published UserDefinedCodeList registries.

HierarchyElementTypeEnum.title: HierarchyElementTypeEnum
HierarchyElementTypeEnum.description:
Defines the supported lists of types of parking hierarchy elements permissible
* campus : a data structure holding information about a large, often ill-defined area, which may contain many parking structures.
* identifiedArea : a data structure holding information about a coherent feature, such as a set of parking spaces that all share the same characteristics.
* place : a data structure holding information about a single identifiable parking place.
* space : a data structure holding information about a single space for parking, usually designed for one vehicle, which may be denoted by painted or other road surface markers.
* subplaceElement : a sub-division of a place for the convenience of the operator that may be used for parking related or other purposes.
* specificArea : a specialisation of an identified area that denotes a specific geographic area in a place that has a common physical infrastructure purpose and common characteristics.
* vehicularAccess : a specialisation of an identified area defining vehicular access areas.
* electricChargingEquipment : a specialisation of a supplemental facility for electric charging areas.
* supplementalEquipment : a specialisation of a supplemental facility which is available on some site, for example on a rest area.
* supplementalServiceFacility : a specialisation of a supplemental facility to specify the type and number of available sub-facilities, for example 20 restaurants.

RightSpecificationTypeEnum.title: RightTypeEnum
RightSpecificationTypeEnum.description:
Defines the type of RightSpecification
* accessPermission : intended grant access permission
* loadingUnloading : intended granting permissions to load and unload vehicles.
* oneTimeUseParking : intended for one time or limited parking usage
* permitParking : intended for multi-use parking usage
* setDownPickup : intended for passenger set down and pick up
* waiting : intended to grant permission for an accompanied vehicle to wait

StructureTypeEnum.title: StructureTypeEnum
StructureTypeEnum.description:
A list of types of parking structure.
* offStreetStructure : Off-street multi-tier parking structure.
* offStreetSurface : Off-street ground-level at grade parking.
* onStreet : On-street parking.

StructureGradeEnum.title: StructureGradeEnum
StructureGradeEnum.description:
Types of layout of the parking site.
* aboveGround : Parking is above ground level (this may include ground level parking)
* groundLevel : Parking is at ground level
* underground : Parking is on one or more floors below ground level

PaginatedListMeta.title: PaginatedListMeta
PaginatedListMeta.description: Metadata for paginated list of results for listing API endpoints.

referenceInstant.description: Unix epoch time to be used as reference which should be the same for all pages. Allows a consistent view of data across multiple paged requests.

offset.description: Index of the first item returned in the page.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of items that can be returned per page.

total.description: Total number of items contained in all pages.

DateTime.title: DateTime
DateTime.description: ISO-8601 format definition of a date and time - format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

DeletedReference.title: DeletedReference
DeletedReference.description: A reference to a deleted identifiable managed object where the identifier is unique. It is described by a string identifying the class of the referenced object (key name) with a unique string identifier as its value, and the deletion instant.

id.description: The unique id of the deleted object.

className.description: The class name of the deleted object.

deleteTimestamp.description: The instant when the reference was deleted.

PaginatedList.title: PaginatedList
PaginatedList.description: Paginated list of results for listing API endpoints.

deletedReferences.description: This attribute will returned when the `modified_since` query parameter is used. It will contain references to deleted resources since the provided instant, that would have otherwise been included in the dataset (either at the top-level or as associated objects).

HierarchyElement.title: HierarchyElement
HierarchyElement.description: A generalised component of a place hierarchy, that forms one element in the tree-like hierarchy. This forms a reusable block of the hierarchy, with relations to its parent element (if one exists) and any child elements. Each Place element in the hierarchy shall have a name, and may support a free-text description and an operator/property owner defined reference (e.g. location number/identifier)'

aliases.description: Alternative names for the hierarchy element.

childIds.description: The identity of one or several child nodes directly related to this hierarchy element.

layer.description: Indicator of the position of this hierarchy element in the specific hierarchy, with the top of the hierarchy numbered layer 0.

Campus.title: Campus
Campus.description: The highest level in the hierarchy, it typically defines a large facility (such as a university campus, or an airport), or a large geographic zone (such as a city or a town), which may contain numerous Places. A Campus combines and encompasses a number of Places that can be logically reported together.

CoveredTypeEnum.title: CoveredTypeEnum
CoveredTypeEnum.description:
Defines the supported lists of different types describing roof coverage of the facility or entity
* covered: Indicates that the facility or specific entity has a roof to provide protection from direct overhead sun or adverse weather
* notCovered: Indicates that the facility or specific entity has no roof to provide protection from direct overhead sun or adverse weather
* partiallyCovered: Indicates that the facility or specific entity has a roof offering partial coverage to provide protection from direct overhead sun or adverse weather
* topLevelNotCovered: Indicates that in a multi-level facility or specific entity the top level(s) have no roof to provide protection from direct overhead sun or adverse weather

AccessibilityTypeEnum.title: AccessibilityTypeEnum
AccessibilityTypeEnum.description:
Special forms of accessibility, easements and marking for disabled people.
* barrierFreeAccessible: Accessible without any steps or other barriers. Does not ensure the same access as disabledAccessible.
* disabledAccessible: Accessible for disabled people. wheelChairAccessible is a special form of it.
* disabledEasements: There are special easements for disabled people, like handrails or disabled-friendly furniture.
* disabledMarkedThere: is a visible mark to support access by disabled people (e.g. a wheelchair symbol).
* none: No form of special accessibility, i.e. usually not convenient for disabled people, e.g. because of steps or barriers.
* orientationSystemForBlindPeople: There is some orientation system, which helps blind or visually impaired people. Examples might be some acoustic system or tactile paving.
* other: Other.
* unknown: It is unknown, whether there is a special form of accessibility.
* wheelChairAccessible: Accessible by people in a wheelchair.

OperatingModeTypeEnum.title: OperatingModeTypeEnum
OperatingModeTypeEnum.description:
A list of supported parking operation modes
* app : App â€“ payment is collected via an app that may also control access to the facility.
* payAndDisplay : PND â€“ pay and display. Vehicle displays a credential to show it is paid. Typically prepaid and short term.
* payByPlate : PBP - pay by plate - vehicle registration or license plate is used for recording and enforcement either on street or off street. Payment is collected on a prepaid basis or at the exit.
* payBySpace : PBS â€“ pay by space. Vehicle makes a payment based on occupying a specific space. Typically prepaid.
* permit : Similar to PND but for long term parking (e.g. monthly pass, quarterly, semester).
* ticket : Payment is done with a ticket (e.g. with magnetic strip, barcode). Payment is collected at the exit.

StaffEnum.title: StaffEnum
StaffEnum.description:
A list of supported values for staffing characteristics
* staffed : Normally staffed during operating hours
* temporary : Staffed on a temporary or part time basis.
* unstaffed : Not normally staffed during operating hours

PlaceCharacteristics.title: PlaceCharacteristics
PlaceCharacteristics.description: Defines information concerning characteristics related to a parking facility.

openToPublic.description: Identifies if this facility is accessible to public use (TRUE) or private use only (FALSE).

accessControlled.description: Indicates facility has physical access control (e.g. barriers, gates) (TRUE) or no access control (FALSE).

robotic.description: Indicates existence of a robotic parking system (a parking structure where customer leaves vehicle at drop off area and robots move the vehicle to parking location within the structure). Default is (FALSE).

disabledAccess.description: Specifies if there is provision of facilities for disable access (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

disabledAccessTypes.description: Defines the type of provision of facilities for disable access available.

operatingModes.description: Defines the mode of parking operation in use.

spacesNonDedicated.description: Number of parking spaces that are not assigned for a particular purpose.

evChargingPoints.description: Total number of electric vehicle charging points.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.description: Address and contact information about some person, service or the parking site, provided in detail or via reference.

contactNotDefined.description: When true, there is currently no contact defined for the selected role and/or timeframe. Don't use the specialisations in this case.

contactUnknown.description: When true, the contact for the selected role and/or timeframe is unknown. Don't use the specialisations in this case.

shareWithPublic.description: When true, the details of this contact may be shared with the public. If false these contacts details are for internal purposes only.

VersionedIdentity.title: VersionedIdentity
VersionedIdentity.description: Represents an object unique identifier associated with a version that can evolve over time.

version.description: Positive integer representing the object version.

SpecificLanguageString.title: SpecificLanguageString
SpecificLanguageString.description: Object containing a language code (using ISO 639-1:2002) and the translated string.

MultilingualString.title: MultilingualString
MultilingualString.description: Array of SpecificLanguageString objects representing multi language text.

ContactPointTypeEnum.title: ContactPointTypeEnum
ContactPointTypeEnum.description:
Defines the supported lists of types of contact.
* customerService : Contact details for parking customer support for a facility or specific entity
* emergencyContact : Contact details for emergency assistance or support for a facility or specific entity specifically related to parking operations
* enforcementSystemProvider : Contact details for the provider of the enforcement system
* operator : Contact details for the parking operator for a facility or specific entity
* owner : Contact details for the owner of a facility or specific entity.
* propertyManager : Contact details for the property manager of a facility or related facility.
* securityService : Contact details for security services for a facility or specific entity
* serviceProvider : Contact details for a parking service provider (e.g. pay-by-mobile provider)

AddressLineTypeEnum.title: AddressLineTypeEnum
AddressLineTypeEnum.description:
A table of types of address lines
 * apartment: Element indicating a discrete element of a building forming the address
 * building: Element identifying the number or name and type of the edifice or construction relevant for the address [derived from ISO19160-4]
 * districtTerritory: Element specifying the geographic or administrative area of the country for the address [Source: 19160-4]
 * floor: Element indicating the floor or level on which a delivery point is located in a multi-storey building [Source:ISO19160-4]
 * poBox: A postal delivery location identifier, not necessarily a physical location.
 * region: Element indicating the name of the area within or adjacent to the town in which delivery address is.
 * street: Element indicating road or street identifier or name 
 * town: Element indicating the name of the populated place in which a delivery point is located, or near to or via which the delivery point is accessed. [Source: ISO19160-4]
 * unit: An element representing a section of a building or organisation.Free-text description of the condition that leads to a surcharge being applied.

AddressLine.title: AddressLine
AddressLine.description: A class defining information concerning one line of a postal address.

order.description: The sequence order that the address line element should be displayed in

Address.title: Address
Address.description: A street oriented addressing structure supporting delivery

postCode.description: Postcode or postal code for the address.

Url.title: Url
Url.description: Represents a Url for an internet accessible resource.

ContactDetails.title: ContactDetails
ContactDetails.description: Details for some person, service or the parking site itself, especially address information.

available24hours.description: Specifies if the availability is 24 hours a day. If true available 24 hours. If omitted, this information is unknown or heterogeneous.

contactDetailsLanguage.description: Language(s) this contact is able to speak resp. understand.

contactPersonFirstName.description: First name of the contact person.

publishingAgreement.description: Indication, whether the contact accepted publishing its contact information [TRUE] = accepted.

EmailTypeEnum.title: EmailTypeEnum
EmailTypeEnum.description:
Defines the supported lists of different email contact types
* customerService: The email contact is for customer service.
* general: The email contact is general in nature.
* helpdesk: The email contact is a helpdesk.
* individual: The email contact is for a specified individual.

EMailCommonData.title: EMailCommonData
EMailCommonData.description: Defines information concerning an email point of contact.

primaryFlag.description: If true, this indicates that this is the primary point of contact

typeCode.description: The type of contact that can be reached with this email

TelephoneContact.title: TelephoneContact
TelephoneContact.description: A class defining information relating to a specific telephone point of contact.

areaCode.description: The area code element of a telephone number.

extensionNumbers.description: Any extension number typically within a larger organisation's telephone exchange system.

ituCountryCode.description: Country calling codes or country dial in codes are telephone dialing prefixes for the member countries or regions of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). They are defined by the ITU-T in standards E.123 and E.164.

localNumbers.description: The local code element of a telephone number.

GeoJsonObject.title: GeoJsonObject
GeoJsonObject.description:
GeoJSon object

The coordinate reference system for all GeoJSON coordinates is a
geographic coordinate reference system, using the World Geodetic System
1984 (WGS 84) datum, with longitude and latitude units of decimal
degrees.
This is equivalent to the coordinate reference system identified by the
Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) URN
An OPTIONAL third-position element SHALL be the height in meters above
or below the WGS 84 reference ellipsoid.
In the absence of elevation values, applications sensitive to height or
depth SHOULD interpret positions as being at local ground or sea level.

bbox.description:
A GeoJSON object MAY have a member named "bbox" to include
information on the coordinate range for its Geometries, Features, or
FeatureCollections. The value of the bbox member MUST be an array of
length 2*n where n is the number of dimensions represented in the
contained geometries, with all axes of the most southwesterly point
followed by all axes of the more northeasterly point. The axes order
of a bbox follows the axes order of geometries.

ContactPoint.title: ContactPoint
ContactPoint.description: Defines contact details for specified role. Organisation name attribute should not be used in combination with role parkingSiteAddress.

VersionedReference.title: VersionedReference
VersionedReference.description: Represents a reference to an identifiable object where the combination of the identifier and version is unique. It is composed of an unique identifier, a version and potentially a string identifying the class of the referenced object.

version.description: Positive integer representing the object version.

className.description: Class name of the referenced object.

ContactByReference.title: ContactByReference
ContactByReference.description: Contact information that is addressed via a reference.

ContactTypeEnum.title: ContactTypeEnum
ContactTypeEnum.description:
Defined the type of contact object.
* ContactPoint: Contact detailed information.
* ContactByReference: Reference to an exiting contact.

DayEnum.title: DayEnum
DayEnum.description: Defines permissible enumerations of identification of days within a week.

MonthEnum.title: MonthEnum
MonthEnum.description: Defines permissible enumerations of identification of calendar months within a year.

WeekOfMonthEnum.title: WeekOfMonthEnum
WeekOfMonthEnum.description:
Weeks of the month

* `firstWeekOfMonth`: First week of the month
* `secondWeekOfMonth`: Second week of the month
* `thirdWeekOfMonth`: Third week of the month
* `fourthWeekOfMonth`: Fourth week of the month
* `fifthWeekOfMonth`: Fifth week of the month (at most only 3 days and non in February when not a leap year)

DayWeekMonth.title: DayWeekMonth
DayWeekMonth.description: Specification of periods defined by the intersection of days, weeks and months.

applicableDay.description: Applicable day of the week (1 to 7). All days of the week is expressed by non-inclusion of this attribute.

applicableMonth.description: Applicable month of the year (1 to 12). All months of the year is expressed by non-inclusion of this attribute.

applicableWeek.description: Applicable week of the month (1 to 5). All weeks of the month is expressed by non-inclusion of this attribute.

SpecialDay.title: SpecialDay
SpecialDay.description: Specification of a special type of day, possibly also a public holiday. Can be country or region specific.

intersectWithApplicableDays.description: Indicates if the period is the intersection of applicable days and this special day (TRUE) or if it is the union of applicable days and this special day.

OtherSpecialDay.title: OtherSpecialDay
OtherSpecialDay.description: Specification of a other type of special day.

PublicHoliday.title: PublicHoliday
PublicHoliday.description: Specification of a specific public holiday in case `specialDayType` is set to `publicHoliday`.

SpecialDayTypeEnum.title: SpecialDayTypeEnum
SpecialDayTypeEnum.description:
Collection of special types of days
* dayBeforePublicHoliday: The day preceding a public holiday
* dayFollowingPublicHoliday: A day following a public holiday
* inLieuOfPublicHoliday: A holiday in lieu of a public holiday that falls on a weekend
* longWeekendDay: A day between a public holiday and the weekend
* other: Some other special day
* publicEventDay: A day of a public event. You may use the publicEvent attribute to specify the corresponding event
* publicHoliday: Public holiday A public holiday in general. You may use the PublicHoliday class to refer on a specific public holiday
* schoolDay: A school day
* schoolHolidays: A day within the school holidays

Time.title: Time
Time.description: ISO-8601 format definition of a time - format HH:MM.

TimePeriodOfDay.title: TimePeriodOfDay
TimePeriodOfDay.description: Specification of a continuous period of time within the same day.

Period.title: Period
Period.description: Defines a continuous time period or a set of discontinuous time periods defined by the intersection of a set of criteria all within an overall delimiting interval.

recurringDayWeekMonthPeriod.description: The list of days each month for the period. If empty, all year (7d/7).

recurringSpecialDay.description: The list of special days for the period.

recurringTimePeriodOfDay.description: The list of start and end time for each day. If empty, all day (24h/24).

OverallPeriod.title: OverallPeriod
OverallPeriod.description: A continuous or discontinuous period of validity defined by overall bounding start and end times and the possible intersection of valid periods (potentially recurring) with the complement of exception periods (also potentially recurring).

overallStartTime.description: Start of bounding period of validity defined by date and time.

overallEndTime.description: End of bounding period of validity defined by date and time.

validPeriods.description: A single time period, a recurring time `Period` period or a set of different recurring time periods during which validity is true.

exceptionPeriods.description: A single time period, a recurring time Period period or a set of different recurring time periods during which validity is false.

ImageAlbum.title: ImageAlbum
ImageAlbum.description: A class defining information relating to images for a parking facility.

logoImage.description: URL to location of logo(s) the parking operator wishes to associate with this parking facility (e.g. their logo, schemes [ParkMark])

Marketing.title: Marketing
Marketing.description: Universal resource locator (URI) that points towards a web site carrying marketing material supplied.

OperatingRestrictionTypeEnum.title: OperatingRestrictionTypeEnum
OperatingRestrictionTypeEnum.description:
Defines operating restrictions to use the of a facility.
* busOnly : Only buses are permitted.
* busStop : This is a stopping place of bus pick-up or drop-off; not to be used for parking.
* carpoolOnly : Only carpool vehicles are permitted.
* commercialVehicleOnly : Only commercial vehicles are permitted.
* disabledPersonPermitOnly : Only vehicles of registered disabled person permit holders permitted.
* electricVehicleOnly : Only electric vehicles permitted.
* freeParking : No fee for parking
* governmentVehicleOnly : Only government vehicles permitted.
* loadingZone : This is a loading zone; not to be used for parking.
* loadingZoneCommercial : Only government vehicles permitted.
* media : Only for use by the media
* noParking : No parking permitted
* noWaiting : No waiting or parking of vehicles is permitted
* parkingTimeLimit : Time limited parking.
* residentialPermitOnly : Only for use by residential permit holders only
* snow : Snow clearing zone; no parking
* streetCleaning : Street cleansing zone; no parking
* taxiOnly : Only taxis are permitted.
* valetOnly : Only valet service vehicles are permitted.

RGBColour.title: RGBColour
RGBColour.description: A RGB colour described by values for red, green and blue (0..255) as well as an optional name.

rgbBlueValue.description: The blue value of the RGB colour (0..255).

rgbGreenValue.description: The green value of the RGB colour (0..255).

rgbRedValue.description: The red value of the RGB colour (0..255).

AccessAndEgress.title: AccessAndEgress
AccessAndEgress.description: Time periods specified for access to or from a parking facility.

exitPossibleAtAnyTime.description: If true, specifies that the specified access is available for exit at all times.

ValidityStatusEnum.title: ValidityStatusEnum
ValidityStatusEnum.description:
Values of validity status that can be assigned to a described event, action or item.
* active : The described event, action or item is currently active regardless of the definition of the validity time specification.
* definedByValidityTimeSpec : The validity status of the described event, action or item is in accordance with the definition of the validity time specification.
* planned : The described event, action or item is currently planned regardless of the definition of the validity time specification.
* suspended : The described event, action or item is currently suspended, that is inactive, regardless of the definition of the validity time specification.

Validity.title: Validity
Validity.description: Specification of validity, either explicitly or by a validity time period specification which may be discontinuous.

AccessAndEgressValidity.title: AccessAndEgressValidity
AccessAndEgressValidity.description: Defines an AccessAndEgress variant with validity.

AccessAndEgressPeriods.title: AccessAndEgressPeriods
AccessAndEgressPeriods.description: Defines an AccessAndEgress variant with periods.

AccessAndEgressTypeEnum.title: AccessAndEgressTypeEnum
AccessAndEgressTypeEnum.description: Defines the type of access and egress for places.

PeriodsOrValidity.title: PeriodsOrValidity
PeriodsOrValidity.description: Describes the mutually exclusive use of one Validity or one or more Periods.

PeriodsOrValidityTypeEnum.title: PeriodsOrValidityTypeEnum
PeriodsOrValidityTypeEnum.description:
Collection of types for PeriodsOrValidity.
* validity: using validity
* periods: using periods

EntranceOpenTime.title: EntranceOpenTime
EntranceOpenTime.description: Specification of periods of times when parking entrance(s) are open for vehicle movements.

ExitOpenTime.title: ExitOpenTime
ExitOpenTime.description: Specification of periods of times when parking exit(s) are open for vehicle movements.

OperatingTime.title: OperatingTime
OperatingTime.description: Specification of periods or time when the parking operates, do not represents times of accessibility.

Times.title: Times
Times.description:
Defines forms of time period for specific purposes. 
There are four distinct time domain concepts: 
* Hours of operation (times at which the facility may be used)
* Access and egress (times it is possible to enter and leave the facility)
* Entrance open time
* Exit open time

available24hours.description: If [TRUE], the identified parking hierarchy entities is available 24 hours per day.

openAllYear.description: If [TRUE], the identified parking hierarchy entities is available every day each year.

openingTimesNotSpecified.description: If [TRUE], the time periods are not specified.

openingTimesUnknown.description: If [TRUE], the time periods are not known.

MeansOfPaymentEnum.title: MeansOfPaymentEnum
MeansOfPaymentEnum.description:
Means of payment
* cashBillsOnly : Cash payment using bills only.
* cashCoinsAndBills : Cash payment using bills and/or coins only.
* cashCoinsOnly : Cash payment with coins only.
* mobileAccount : Payment method using an app or other functions typically via a smartphone, to a linked bank or card account.
* paymentCreditCard : Payment by electronic payment credit card which is a small plastic card issued by a bank, building society, or  other financial institution (ISO/IEC 7813 and other related standards), allowing the holder to purchase goods or services on credit.
* paymentDebitCard : Payment by electronic payment debit card which is a small plastic card (ISO/IEC 7813 and other related standards), allowing the holder to transfer money electronically from their bank account when making a purchase.
* paymentValueCard : Payment by electronic payment debit card which is a small plastic card (ISO/IEC 7813 and other related standards)  with a monetary value stored on the card itself, not that may not be linked to an external account maintained by a financial institution.
* prepay : Advanced payment for parking right.
* tollTag : Toll tag (RFID) or similar, with associated account.
* unknown : Unknown.

PaymentTimingEnum.title: PaymentTimingEnum
PaymentTimingEnum.description:
Details of when payment is required.
* other : Other.
* payAfterExit : Payment on account
* payAndExit : Pay directly at the exit with a payment card or other means of payment (usually, this payment card must have been used when entering as well).
* payOnEntry : Pay at start of the parking session (e.g. for pay and display)
* payPriorToExit : Pay at machine on foot prior to returning to vehicle and use payment ticket to exit.
* prepay : Pay before entry

Reference.title: Reference
Reference.description: Represents a reference to an identifiable object where the identifier is unique. It is composed of an unique identifier and a string identifying the class of the referenced object. If multiple versions exists for the object, the latest version is considered.

id.description: The unique identifier within the given class.

className.description: The class name of the referenced object in PascalCase.

ReferencedCodeListEntry.title: ReferencedCodeListEntry
ReferencedCodeListEntry.description: Provides a structure to support reference to an entry in a previously defined user-defined code list.

entryDefinedValue.description: Free-text defined text (name) for the code list entry being referenced.

BrandsAcceptedCodeList.title: BrandsAcceptedCodeList
BrandsAcceptedCodeList.description: Use this class to describe details of the brands that are accepted.

BrandsAcceptedText.title: BrandsAcceptedText
BrandsAcceptedText.description: Use this class to describe details of the brands that are accepted.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: Provides information on the means of payment available

paymentMode.description: Defines the timing of the parking or other mobility related payment

brandsAcceptedCodeList.description: List of accepted brands for payment cards (by code)

brandsAcceptedText.description: List of accepted brands for payment cards (by name)

SafetyStandardClassification.title: SafetyStandardClassification
SafetyStandardClassification.description: Use this class to classification type/level for security schemes for a place

PlaceInformation.title: PlaceInformation
PlaceInformation.description: Defines information concerning multiple features relating to parking hierarchy elements.

Place.title: Place
Place.description: A place or location used for parking, loading, unloading, standing, or some other mobility or transport related activity. Place typically identifies a parking structure, surface lot or on street parking zone

ParkingSpaceOccupancyDetectionEnum.title: ParkingSpaceOccupancyDetectionEnum
ParkingSpaceOccupancyDetectionEnum.description:
A list of supported methods for detection of occupancy by a vehicle in a parking space.
* anpr : Automated License Plate Recognition information is tracked for inbound and outbound traffic. The difference between in and out counts enables an occupancy count.
* imageAnalytics : Image analytics are used to evaluate a picture with known parking space geography and computer vision is used to determine occupancy at a point in time.
* spaceSensor : A sensor in each space detects the presence of a vehicle.
* userDeclaration : User self-declared, where the user enters a space identifier and/or vehicle registration number, typically at the start of a parking session.
* videoAnalytics : Video analytics are used to evaluate a video stream to identify objects (vehicles) and direction of travel. The difference between the inbound objects and outbound objects determines occupancy.
* videoSpace : Video analytics or ANPR technologies are used to evaluate a video stream with known space geometry to identify objects (vehicles or license plates) occupying specific spaces.
* visual : Operator/owner makes periodic visual counts of the facility.

CalculationTypeEnum.description:

* counted : Physical determination if a space is occupied
* derived : Space occupancy is estimated by using related data such as active payments or sold permits.
* expected : Future prediction of occupancy levels.
* verified : Defines an occupancy report that is considered a verified report.

SupplyViewTypeEnum.description:
Define if space quantity is demarcated or estimated.
* spaceView : Each space is physically marked and identifiable.
* vehicleView :  The vehicle capacity in an area is estimated based on calculating a capacity (i.e. curb length divided by a length of vehicle). The
distributing party decides on the appropriate length of vehicle to use.

Supply.title: Supply
Supply.description:
A class defining concepts relating the parameters of the supply of parking. 
This is the total number of spaces usable for parking or other mobility operations. 
It can be defined as demarcated spaces or non-demarcated.

supplyQuantity.description: Indicates the numeric value of available parking or other space uses.

supplyValidityStart.description: Valid start date/time for the supply

supplyValidityEnd.description: Valid end date/time for the supply

HierarchyElementReference.title: HierarchyElementReference
HierarchyElementReference.description: A class providing a unique reference identifier for a discrete part of the parking place hierarchy. This can indicate a campus, parking place, hierarchy element, identifiable area or space.

ResponsibilityRoleAssignment.title: ResponsibilityRoleAssignment
ResponsibilityRoleAssignment.description: describes roles and responsibilites for a particular location (e.g. operator)

ResponseStatusEnum.title: ResponseStatusEnum
ResponseStatusEnum.description:
Type of status for a Response.
* ok : OK
* error : An error occurred

ResponseStatus.title: ResponseStatus
ResponseStatus.description: Codifies responses following some creation, update or delete operation.

status.description: The status code of the response.

code.description: Same numbering and semantics as HTTP status codes.

ObservationTypeEnum.title: ObservationTypeEnum
ObservationTypeEnum.description:
A list of the supported observation types.

* `anpr`: Automatic vehicle license plate recognition
* `chalk`: Chalk-mark observation or similar
* `rfTransponder`: Rf transponder radio frequency transponder device, for toll tag or similar radio based devices
* `scanner`: Handheld or fixed scanning device (optical)
* `visual`: Visual (human) observation

CredentialTypeEnum.title: CredentialTypeEnum
CredentialTypeEnum.description:
* barcode : barcode or QR digital print pattern, held on any physical media.
* bluetooth : specific bluetooth or BLE identification chip used to associate a BLE receiver to a specific user.  Used for both one time and permit uses.
* eticket : digital equivalent of a paper ticket, often presentable via smartphone or similar device for control.
* hangtag : visible, often removable, credential indicator, with visible markings
* licensePlate : fixed plate, in a defined format, used to identify a specific vehicle- Normally a permanent fixture.
* permit : issued credential, often in the form of an adhesive label, often placed on the windscreen, credential indicator, with visible markings
* qrCode : quick Reference (QR) code
* rfid : specific RF identification associated to an RFID-related account.  Used for permit uses.
* ticket : typically issued paper with printed details, often with magnetic strips; typically single use disposable.
* electronicID : an identifier transmitted by electronic means
* ticketcoupon : a visible printed or written paper-based ticket or coupon carrying an identifiable credential.
* vehicleplate : a fixed identifier (registration plate) visible and fixed to a vehicle.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Positional information relating to an observation for both the observation target ('observed') and the source ('observer').

ImageTypeEnum.title: ImageTypeEnum
ImageTypeEnum.description: the nature of the captured image

Image.title: Image
Image.description: Class containing information relating to still or moving image observation evidence or a reference (link) to such observation evidence.

id.description: Reference identifier to a specific image.

image.description: Base64 File or binary object containing a still or moving image.

cameraID.description: identification code for the camera device

cameraDistance.description: recorded distance in metres between the camera and observation

VehicleAncillaryIdentification.title: VehicleAncillaryIdentification
VehicleAncillaryIdentification.description: Information relating to a specific vehicle.

color.description: The predominant colour of the vehicle.

description.description: Free-text description of other distinguishing features of the vehicle.

make.description: The branded manufacturer's name for the vehicle (e.g. Ford, Audi, BMW, Mazda).

model.description: The model name for the vehicle type (e.g. Ford Mondeo, Citroen C-Zero).

stateProvince.description: State, province or other administrative subdivision where a nation state permits registration of vehicles on a lower administrative level basis.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: overall confidence of the observation measurement

overallConfidence.description: overall confidence of the observation measurement - can be vendor-specific but rescaled to a value between 0 and 1, with 1 being greatest confidence

confidence.description: confidence of the observation measurement for a specific indexed character - can be vendor-specific but rescaled to a value between 0 and 1, with 1 being greatest confidence

index.description: index reference to a specific character within an observed sequence

ObservationElement.title: ObservationElement

observer.description: The individual person making the observation recorded in this observation element.

observedCredentialId.description: Specific identifier to the referenced observed credential.

observationStartTime.description: The initial date and time of the observation.

observationEndTime.description: The ending date and time of the observation, when it was continous since `observationStartTime`.

creationDateTime.description: The date and time stamp for the creation of the observation element.

images.description: still or moving images observation evidence or a reference to such observation evidence

ObservationElement.description: A specific collection of observation details intended to be used for one specific observation instance.

ObservationDataType.title: ObservationDataType
ObservationDataType.description: used as discriminator between a single observation element and an observation set

ObservationSet.title: ObservationSet
ObservationSet.description: Details of the collection of a set of related recorded observations.

The date and time of the creation of the
observation set.

availableAssignedRights.description: Defines the number of AssignedRights that have been issued by the issuer that are still available to be assigned.

qtyRelation.description: Defines the number of actions or parking included in a RightSpecification.

FuelTypeEnum.title: FuelTypeEnum
FuelTypeEnum.description:
Type of fuel used by a vehicle : 
* all : All sort of fuel is accepted
* battery : Battery
* biodiesel : Biodiesel
* diesel : Fuel used for compression - ignition (CI) engines
* dieselBatteryHybrid : Diesel and battery hybrid
* ethanol : Ethanol\n* hydrogen: Hydrogen
* liquidGas : Liquid gas of any type including LPG
* lpg : Liquid petroleum gas\n* methane: Methane gas
* other : Other
* petrol: Fuel used for positive-ignition (PI) engines
* petrol95Octane : Petrol with 95 octane\n* petrol98Octane: Petrol with 98 octane
* petrolBatteryHybrid : Petrol and battery hybrid
* petrolLeaded : Leaded petrol
* petrolUnleaded : Unleaded petrol
* unknown : The sort of fuel is not known"

LowEmissionLevelEnum.title: LowEmissionLevelEnum
LowEmissionLevelEnum.description:
The emission level of a vehicle
* freeOfEmission : Only vehicles that do not produce emissions (e.g. electric driven). Hybrid driven cars are allowed, when they switch to emission free mode within the considered situation
* lowLevelEmission : Vehicles with low level emission

ComparisonOperatorEnum.title: ComparisonOperatorEnum
ComparisonOperatorEnum.description:
Logical comparison operations
* equalTo : Logical comparison operator of "equal to".
* greaterThan : Logical comparison operator of "greater than".
* greaterThanOrEqualTo : Logical comparison operator of "greater than or equal to".
* lessThan : Logical comparison operator of "less than".
* lessThanOrEqualTo : Logical comparison operator of "less than or equal to".

emissionClassificationOther.description: Some other (probably locally defined) value(s) for emission classification.

WeightTypeEnum.title: WeightTypeEnum
WeightTypeEnum.description:
Type of weight - describing the meaning of a vehicle weight value
* actual : The weight is the actual weight of a specific vehicle
* maximumPermitted : The weight is the maximum permitted weight for a vehicle

GrossWeightCharacteristic.title: GrossWeightCharacteristic
GrossWeightCharacteristic.description: Gross weight characteristic of a vehicle.

grossVehicleWeight.description: The gross weight of the vehicle and its load, including any trailers (in Tonnes).

vehicleHeight.description: The height (in metres) of the highest part, excluding antennae, of an individual vehicle above the road surface.

vehicleLength.description: The overall distance (in metres) between the front and back of an individual vehicle, including the length of any trailers, couplings or embedded features.

vehicleWidth.description: The maximum width of an individual vehicle, including any features embedded or fixed on it, in metres

VehicleTypeEnum.title: VehicleTypeEnum
VehicleTypeEnum.description:
* agriculturalVehicle : Vehicle normally used for agricultural purposes (e.g. tractor, combined harvester).
* anyVehicle : Vehicle of any type.
* articulatedBus : Articulated bus
* articulatedTrolleyBus : Articulated trolley bus
* articulatedVehicle : Articulated vehicle.
* bicycle : Bicycle.
* bus : Bus.
* car : Vehicles designed and constructed for the carriage of passengers and comprising no more than eight seats (in addition to the driver seat), and having a maximum mass (technically permissible maximum laden mass) not exceeding 3.5 tons (M1).
* caravan : Caravan.
* carOrLightVehicle : Car or light vehicle.
* carWithCaravan : Car towing a caravan.
* carWithTrailer : Car towing a trailer.
* constructionOrMaintenanceVehicle : Vehicle normally used for construction or maintenance purposes (e.g. digger, excavator, bulldozer, lorry mounted crane)
* fourWheelDrive : Four wheel drive vehicle.
* heavyDutyTransporter : A transporter for heavy duty (usually with abnormal dimensions).
* heavyGoodsVehicle : Vehicles with a total weight above 3,500 kg (vehicle and load).
* heavyGoodsVehicleWithTrailer : Heavy goods vehicle with trailer
* heavyVehicle : Vehicle whose weight means it should be classed as a heavy vehicle
* highSidedVehicle : High sided vehicle.
* largeCar : Large car
* largeGoodsVehicle : Vehicles for the carriage of goods and having a maximum mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes (belonging to class N2 when not exceeding 12 tonnes, otherwise class N3).
* lightCommercialVehicle : Vehicles for the carriage of goods and having a maximum mass not exceeding 3.5 tonnes (class N1).
* lightCommercialVehicleWithTrailer : Light goods vehicle with trailer
* longHeavyLorry : A heavy lorry that is longer than normal.
* lorry : Lorry of any type.
* metro : Metro
* minibus : Vehicles designed and constructed for the carriage of passengers, comprising more than eight seats (in addition to the driver seat), and having a maximum mass not exceeding 5 tonnes (class M2).
* moped : Moped (a two wheeled motor vehicle characterized by a small engine typically less than 50cc and by normally having pedals).
* motorcycle : Motorcycle.
* motorcycleWithSideCar : Three wheeled vehicle comprising a motorcycle with an attached side car.
* motorhome : motorhome
* motorScooter : MotorScooter (a two wheeled motor vehicle characterized by a step-through frame and small diameter wheels).
* other : Other than as defined in this enumeration.
* passengerCar : Passenger car
* smallCar : Small car
* tanker : Vehicle with large tank for carrying bulk liquids.
* threeWheeledVehicle : Three wheeled vehicle of unspecified type.
* trailer : Trailer.
* tram : Tram.
* trolleyBus : Trolley bus
* twoWheeledVehicle : Two wheeled vehicle of unspecified type.
* unknown : Unknown.
* van : Van.
* vehicleWithCaravan : Vehicle (of unspecified type) towing a caravan.
* vehicleWithCatalyticConverter : Vehicle with catalytic converter.
* vehicleWithoutCatalyticConverter : Vehicle without catalytic converter.
* vehicleWithTrailer : Vehicle (of unspecified type) towing a trailer.
* withEvenNumberedRegistrationPlates : Vehicle with even numbered registration plate.
* withOddNumberedRegistrationPlates : Vehicle with odd numbered registration plate.

VehicleLoadTypeEnum.title: VehicleLoadTypeEnum
VehicleLoadTypeEnum.description:
* abnormalLoad : A load that exceeds normal vehicle dimensions in terms of height, length, width, gross vehicle weight or axle weight or any combination of these. Generally termed an "abnormal load".
* ammunition : Ammunition.
* chemicals : Chemicals of unspecified type.
* combustibleMaterials : Combustible materials of unspecified type.
* corrosiveMaterials : Corrosive materials of unspecified type.
* debris : Debris of unspecified type.
* empty : No load.
* explosiveMaterials : Explosive materials of unspecified type.
* extraHighLoad : A load of exceptional height.
* extraLongLoad : A load of exceptional length.
* extraWideLoad : A load of exceptional width.
* fuel : Fuel of unspecified type.
* glass : Glass.
* goods : Any goods of a commercial nature.
* hazardousMaterials : Materials classed as being of a hazardous nature.
* liquid : Liquid of an unspecified nature.
* livestock : Livestock.
* materials : General materials of unspecified type.
* materialsDangerousForPeople : Materials classed as being of a danger to people or animals.
* materialsDangerousForTheEnvironment : Materials classed as being potentially dangerous to the environment.
* materialsDangerousForWater : Materials classed as being dangerous when exposed to water (e.g. materials which may react exothermically with water).
* oil : Oil.
* ordinary : Materials that present limited environmental or health risk. Non-combustible, non-toxic, non-corrosive.
* other : Other than as defined in this enumeration.
* perishableProducts : Products or produce that will significantly degrade in quality or freshness over a short period of time.
* petrol : Petrol or petroleum.
* pharmaceuticalMaterials : Pharmaceutical materials.
* radioactiveMaterials : Materials that emit significant quantities of electro-magnetic radiation that may present a risk to people, animals or the environment.
* refrigeratedGoods : Refrigerated goods.
* refuse : Refuse.
* toxicMaterials : Materials of a toxic nature which may damage the environment or endanger public health.
* vehicles : Vehicles of any type which are being transported.

AssignRightTime.description: Qualification criteria for eligibility based on the duration of time relative to a defined time based qualification related to an assigned right.

Qualification.description: Defines a set of criteria used to test eligibility for using a specific RateTable.

freeToPark.description: Indicates that a parking is free (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

withReservation.description: Indicates whether a reservation is required (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
